title: The spectrum of an Artinian ring is finite
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative Artinian ring, meaning that every descending chain of ideals of $B$ is eventually constant. Then the set $\operatorname{Spec}B$ of prime ideals of $B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is finite. The zero ring is allowed.

source.place: Tag 00J7, lemma-artinian-finite-nr-max, finiteness of maximal ideals; Tag 00KH, lemma-Noetherian-dimension-0, converse and last paragraph: every prime of an Artinian ring is maximal. Together these give the stated finite spectrum.
